structured_output.title: Let's Encrypt label addition plausibly applies
structured_output.content: This environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 with `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` resources in active use. The change adds a label to Let's Encrypt account keys created by cert-manager during ACME certificate issuance. If your Certificates use Let's Encrypt ACME issuers, the account key secrets will receive the new label in v1.18.0. Inspect your Certificate resources and ClusterIssuer/Issuer definitions to confirm whether any use Let's Encrypt; if so, expect this metadata addition to account key secrets.
